54:1: The Hour has approached and the moon has split.
54:2: If they see a sign, they turn away and say: 'This is an ongoing magic.'
54:3: They denied and followed their desires, and every matter is settled.
54:4: And by oath, there has come to them news in which there is deterrence.
54:5: It is a far-reaching wisdom, but warnings do not benefit.
54:6: So turn away from them, on the day the caller calls to an unseen thing.
54:7: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as if they were scattered locusts.
54:8: Rushing toward the caller. The disbelievers say: 'This is a difficult day.'
54:9: The people of Noah denied before them; they denied Our servant and said: "Madman" and (he) was thwarted.
54:10: Thereupon he prayed to his Rabb: 'I have been overcome, so help.'
54:11: Thereupon We opened the gates of heaven with pouring water.
54:12: And We caused the earth to gush forth as springs, so the waters met for a decreed matter.
54:13: And We carried him upon that which possesses planks and nails.
54:14: Sailing before Our eyes, as a reward for the one who had been denied.
54:15: And by oath, We left it as a sign; is there any who takes heed?
54:16: How then were My punishment and My warnings!
54:17: And by oath, We have made the Quran easy for admonition; is there any who takes heed?
54:18: Aad denied; how then were My punishment and My warnings?
54:19: Indeed, We sent upon them a freezing wind on a day of continuous ill fortune.
54:20: Plucking people away as if they were uprooted palm trunks.
54:21: How then was My punishment and My warnings!
54:22: And by oath, We have made the Quran easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who takes heed?
54:24: Then they said: 'Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Indeed, we would then surely be in error and madness.'
54:25: Has the remembrance been cast upon him from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar.
54:26: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.
54:27: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as a trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
54:28: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each drinking turn is determined.
54:29: Thereupon they called their companion, so he took it upon himself and slaughtered the she-camel.
54:30: How then was My punishment and My warnings!
54:31: Indeed, We sent upon them a single cry, so they became like the dry twigs of a fence-maker.
54:32: And by oath, We have made the Quran easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who takes heed?
54:33: The people of Lot denied the warnings.
54:34: Indeed, We sent upon them a stone-bearing wind, except the family of Lot; We saved them at the break of dawn.
54:35: As a blessing from Our presence. Thus do We reward the one who gives thanks.
54:36: And by oath, he warned them of Our seizure, but they disputed the warnings with doubt.
54:37: And by oath, they sought to take their desire from his guests, so We wiped out their eyes: 'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'
54:38: And by oath, an abiding punishment seized them in the morning.
54:39: So taste My punishment and My warnings!
54:40: And by oath, We have made the Quran easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who takes heed?
54:41: And by oath, the warnings came to the dynasty of Pharaoh.
54:42: They denied all of Our signs, so We seized them with the seizure of One Mighty and Powerful.
54:43: Are your disbelievers better than those, or is there an immunity for you in the scriptures?
54:44: Or do they say: 'We are an assembly taking revenge'?
54:45: That assembly will soon be defeated and they will turn their backs.
54:46: Nay, the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more grievous and more bitter.
54:47: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
54:48: That day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces: 'Taste the touch of Saqar!'
54:49: Indeed, We have created everything with a measure.
54:50: And Our command is but like the blink of an eye.
54:51: And by oath, We destroyed your factions. Is there anyone who reflects?
54:52: And everything they did is in the books.
54:53: Every small and great thing is written down.
54:54: Indeed, the righteous are in gardens and rivers.
54:55: In a seat of truth, in the presence of an All-Powerful Sovereign.
